story_type: rocket-fired mine clearing line charge detonation
hook: A rocket drags almost a ton of C4 across a field.
narration: This is a minefield breaching charge, fired by soldiers.
A rocket drags out a long line of explosives.
Inside it is almost a ton of C4.
outcome: Then the whole line went off.
title: Rocket drags nearly a ton of C4
description:
U.S. Army engineers at Fort Leonard Wood, Missouri, cross-train with Australian Defence Force soldiers on the Mine Clearing Line Charge, or MICLIC, a rocket-launched line of explosives that blasts a lane through a minefield.

Footage: U.S. Army video by Maria Cassidy, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1026912
